How We Assist Walk-in Visitors:

Visitors to the counter will have a support ticket created on their behalf in LicensE by front counter staff. These tickets will be assigned to the appropriate representative for further assistance.

Credentialing staff will review submitted support tickets and follow up directly with applicants via email or phone. All inquiries will be replied to within three business days.

# DSPS (Digital Systems and Payment Solutions)

DSPS (Digital Systems and Payment Solutions) is a Appliances, Electrical, and Electronics Manufacturing company. DSPS (Digital Systems and Payment Solutions) employs 2 people (+50.0% YoY, +2 people) and has an annual revenue of $18.9M, founded in 2015. Headquartered in Dubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with presence in United States, Australia, and China. Its workforce is distributed across United Arab Emirates and China.

## About

In a world of increasing security risks, regulatory demands, and shrinking budgets, organizations must deliver secure and efficient payment ecosystems. These challenges define the work of DSPS – Digital Systems and Payment Solutions. We believe that well-designed digital systems and payment solutions play a critical role in solving today’s complex operational and financial challenges.

DSPS’s mission is to transform businesses and public-sector organizations through secure, scalable, and user-focused digital systems and payment solutions that truly matter.

Our approach goes beyond technology alone. In the payments industry, success depends on how systems are integrated, adopted, and used. DSPS combines robust system architecture, high security, and regulatory awareness with intuitive and elegant user experiences. By applying the latest advancements in digital platforms and payment technologies, we enable reliable performance and long-term value.

DSPS develops solutions that address real-world needs, including transaction processing, system integration, security, and operational efficiency. Our products are designed to be resilient, easy to use, and future-ready.

Through specialized in-house business units, DSPS brings deep market and domain expertise to every project. By combining advanced technology with detailed industry insight, we deliver balanced solutions that meet today’s requirements while anticipating tomorrow’s challenges.

Collaboration and entrepreneurship are central to the DSPS culture. Our flat organizational structure ensures decisions are driven by ideas, not hierarchy. Initiative, creativity, and accountability define how we work, enabling faster time to market and continuous innovation.

DSPS – Digital Systems and Payment Solutions was established in 2015 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

DSPS – Transforming businesses through digital systems and payment solutions
